# Infinite Red — account brief

## Who

Infinite Red is a consultancy specializing in React Native app design and development ([source](https://infinitered.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the name Infinite Red and the site infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `infinitered/ignite` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `infinitered/ignite` declares react-native 0.74.5 in package.json ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)).
- `infinitered/ignite` has CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 150 public repos and 2100 followers ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).
- `infinitered/ignite` last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)).
- Infinite Red links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://infinitered.com/careers)). The evidence does not say what roles, if any, are open there.

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@infinitered-maintainer-1), top contributor to `infinitered/ignite` with 310 commits ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)). Their GitHub profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)). No title, location, or bio in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@infinitered-maintainer-2), 188 commits to `infinitered/ignite` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)). No title, location, or bio in the evidence.
- Maintainer Three (@infinitered-maintainer-3), 97 commits to `infinitered/ignite` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Infinite Red" and website https://infinitered.com ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3)). No title, location, or bio in the evidence.

## Why now

`infinitered/ignite` last pushed 2026-08-11, twelve days before this brief ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)), and it is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)). There is no store listing or release cadence in the evidence, so how often client apps ship is unknown.

## Suggested opener

Addressed to Maintainer One, top contributor to `ignite` (Staff React Native Engineer persona).

You have 310 commits in `infinitered/ignite`, the most of anyone on it ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1)), and the repo ships an `eas.json` alongside its GitHub Actions workflows ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json), [source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)). It last pushed on 2026-08-11 on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite), [source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)). When a team starts from Ignite, does the `eas.json` in the template carry through to their builds, or do the workflows take over and do the building themselves?
